model: ML1 fault risk: CatBoost per farm + GRU (groups + PCA 16), 50/50 blend of standardised logits
target: k = 7: day t is inside an anomaly window, or one starts within the next 7 days
features: daily deviation table of notebooks/care_catboost_baseline.ipynb sections 1-5 (|rz| of every sensor against its operating-point model on the trailing baseline [t-180, t-60), daily mean and 95th percentile, group aggregates); rows sorted by timeline and day

alarm_rules.budget_1: 2 of the last 3 days at or above the threshold
alarm_rules.recall_80: any day at or above the threshold
alarm_rules.recall_90: any day at or above the threshold
